correctness.presentationDifferenceExplanation: Exact rational LLL followed by a conventional 320-bit Gram--Schmidt calculation selects a slightly different valid candidate order from PARI. The terminal collector semantics and Smith result agree.

comparison.pariBoundaryWarning: This PARI observation returns the H1 class number, but it is not instrumented at precisely the same internal start and stop instructions as the Rust boundary. It establishes the performance regime, not a certified speed ratio.
comparison.matchedFullBoundaryWarning: The matched flag-zero experiment continues through compact p192 PRECI publication and includes downstream work outside this Rust experiment. It must not be used as a direct Rust/PARI ratio.
